options.brief: Accurate and practical. Procrastination is mostly about avoiding unpleasant feelings, not laziness. Explain the rule (commit to just 5 minutes, with real permission to stop), why it works (starting is the hardest part; once started, momentum and the urge to finish unfinished tasks keep you going), one concrete everyday example (e.g. a messy kitchen or a report), and 3 tips to apply it (set a visible timer, make the first step tiny and specific, remove friction). No made-up statistics.
